svg.aria-label: Introduction: a Slytherin developer forging digital spells with Kotlin, JavaScript, Python and C sharp

g.text: Sorted into Slytherin, armed with a laptop and a deeply unreasonable amount of curiosity.
I forge digital spells at the edge of Android, AI and the web — from an AI health companion
brewed for SIH 2026 to face-recognition charms and chatting enchantments. When I'm not
unmasking bugs, I'm plotting the next Grimoire to ship before the moon rises.

text.tspan: Kotlin apps · intelligent systems · clean interfaces
turning “what if?” into “it's live” before the deadline
